name: ThemeToggle
label: Theme toggle
description: The colour-mode control: System, Light and Dark over a stored setting, with the script that applies it before first paint.

props.name: value
props.description:
The setting shown, for a host that owns colour mode (its own settings
store, or a library such as next-themes). A pick then only calls
`onValueChange`, and the host applies it. Leave undefined to let the
toggle keep the setting in its own store, `useColorMode`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The setting applied when the store holds no choice yet, for uncontrolled use. Without it, a first visit follows the operating system.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the setting after every pick, controlled or not.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size, on SegmentedControl's scale: `default` (the default), the height of the CommandPaletteTrigger and AiButton beside it in a top bar, or `compact`.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Show each segment's label beside its icon. Set `false` for an icon-only strip: each label becomes the segment's tooltip on hover and keyboard focus, and stays its accessible name.

props.name: cycle
props.description:
Draw one circle that shows the current setting and steps to the next on
each press (System, Light, Dark), in place of the strip, for a row short
of room, such as a condensed SiteHeader's `condensedActions`. Each label
becomes the circle's tooltip and its accessible name comes from `cycleLabel`.

props.name: cycleLabel
props.description: The cycle circle's accessible name, from the current setting's label and the next one's. Default: the control's `aria-label`, then both, as in "Colour mode: Light. Switch to Dark".

props.name: storageKey
props.description: The localStorage key the choice is kept under. Match the key given to `colorModeScript`. Default `theme`.

props.name: systemLabel
props.description: Label of the setting that follows the operating system.
